clients.name: Veriserv
clients.industry: Commercial vehicle finance, insurance and fleet technology
clients.intro: A refreshed logo, a new website, a social media campaign and ongoing search care for a business that helps South African companies fund, insure and keep track of their commercial vehicles.

cover.alt: The new Veriserv home page on a desktop screen.

work.title: Website redesign
work.summary: The new site gives each part of Veriserv's business its own clear page: finance and insurance, fleet solutions, the K220 and K245C dashcams and a contact page, all built to work well on a phone.

before.alt: The top of the old Veriserv website: a dark menu bar, a photo of a hand on a glowing tablet and the heading Our Products and Services.

after.alt: The top of the new Veriserv website: the refreshed logo, a clear menu and the headline Optimised Commercial Mobility For Sustainable Business Growth.

work.title: Logo refinement

facts.What changed: Proportions, slogan position and slogan wording

work.summary: The icon, name and slogan were rebalanced on a 3x3 grid so the logo reads as one unit, from a website header down to a profile picture. The slogan changed from Sustainable Mobility Solutions to Commercial Mobility Solutions, which says straight away who Veriserv serves.

before.alt: The old Veriserv logo: a large green-to-blue tick beside a smaller VERISERV wordmark.

after.alt: The refined Veriserv logo: a rebalanced tick and wordmark with Commercial Mobility Solutions centred underneath.

work.title: Digital business cards and email signatures

facts.Made for: Each director, in the new brand

work.summary: Digital business cards with a QR code that saves the contact straight to a phone, and matching email signatures with a photo, contact details, social links and Veriserv’s FSP number, so every email carries the new brand.

images.alt: A Veriserv email signature for director Michael Faulds, with his photo, contact details, social icons, a QR code and the Veriserv logo.

clients.name: Sacred Sage
clients.intro: A new logo and a 17-card social media campaign for Sacred Sage Rituals, a South African skincare range built around a simple, balancing daily Ritual.

cover.alt: Three Sacred Sage campaign cards side by side on a warm sand background.

work.title: Logo redesign

facts.What changed: A new icon, cleaner lettering and versions for every size

work.summary: The round stamp with its tree made way for a new logo built around a crescent moon, a line of balance points and soft waves. The line Beyond Suppression. Into Regulation. stays, now set clearly under the name, with a wide version for headers and a stacked one for profile pictures and packaging.

before.alt: The old Sacred Sage logo: a round sand-coloured stamp with the name, the line Beyond Suppression. Into Regulation. and a small tree.

after.alt: The new Sacred Sage logo: a crescent moon with balance points and waves above the name and the line Beyond Suppression. Into Regulation.

work.title: Isuzu Golf Day 2026

facts.What we did: Photography on the day and an online gallery for the client
